thread:
jen: Thanks everyone — posting the security/privacy/compliance follow-ups from today's all-hands here. If you asked a question live, drop any clarifying details and we'll track actions. @sarah-l and @priya-k are the owners for SOC2/ISO and KMS/VPC respectively.

dinesh: Quick follow-up — for SOC2 auditors we need exportable evidence for audit logs. What time range can we produce on short notice? :thinking_face:

sarah-l: Short answer: we can generate a tamper-evident bundle for the last 13 months from hosted by default. For Dedicated/Private, retention is configurable per contract. We can also provide signed manifests for exports.

mika: Is the 13 months hot/fast queryable or do older segments go to cold storage? Asking because our SREs sometimes need quick lookups.

sarah-l: First 13 months are available in warm storage (queryable within minutes). We tier older than that to customer-configured cold archives (GCS/S3) which take longer to query (hours). We keep audit integrity metadata online for the full retention window.

priya-k: Additional note on ISO scope — ISO audits expect evidence of config snapshots and change history. We snapshot IAM, VPC, and KMS policies weekly and keep diffs for 3 years. If you need a point-in-time snapshot for a given date range we can generate that and include the git-backed config tree.

dinesh: Great. For BYOK/Key rotation: customers ask whether we support scheduled rotation and if we can prove key history to auditors. What's the timeline?

priya-k: BYOK is GA for Private deployments. Rotation support (scheduled automated rotation + rotation history UI) is planned for Q4. For now, rotation events are logged with immutable audit entries and we can export key-change events as part of the evidence bundle.

dan: For Dedicated customers we already offer a rotation runbook and can set up a rotation schedule during onboarding.

mika: How do we handle cross-region replication of audit logs for DR? Can we stream to customer buckets in multiple regions?

dan: Yes — we offer configurable replication targets. Example (pseudo-config):
```
replication:
  - target: gs://redwood-audit-prod-us
    region: us-central1
  - target: s3://corp-audit-eu
    region: eu-west-1
  retention_days: 3650
```
Replication to customer-managed buckets uses signed write tokens; for compliance we also produce a signed manifest and checksum chain.

dinesh: Any PII redaction on audit logs before export? We support redaction for high-sensitivity fields but we keep raw logs in the secure audit store when required by the customer (and record who accessed them).

mika: GDPR/DSR question — if a data subject request touches logs, what's the playbook?

sarah-l: We don't redact historical audit metadata required for compliance audits, but we do have a DSR workflow: if a request includes personal data present in logs, we coordinate with legal and the customer (for private deployments) to redact or provide a lawful basis. We log the DSR handling as part of the audit trail.

jen: Action items: @dinesh to request a sample evidence export for the SOC2 team by EOD Friday. @priya-k to post BYOK/rotation roadmap link + GA checklist in #security-docs by next Wed. @dan to add replication config example to the docs. I'll sync with compliance on retention policy language for marketing. :white_check_mark:

dinesh: Thanks — I'll file the export ticket now (will include exact date range).

compliance-bot: Reminder: SOC2 timeline milestone — evidence freeze requested 2 weeks prior to auditor review window.

priya-k: Posted interim notes + a short FAQ in https://redwood.docs.internal/security/audit-evidence (will update with rotation timeline). Ping me if you want office hours for deeper follow-ups.

mika: Can we get a 30-min office hours slot next week focused on Private deployment evidence packaging?

sarah-l: Yes — scheduling now. Will post the invite and include a checklist for what to bring (scoped systems, dates, and sample queries).

jen: Thanks all. If anything urgent pop a mention here and we'll prioritize.
